title: The Righteous Person: A Tree Planted by Streams
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, cinematic widescreen composition in the ancient land of Israel. Show a faithful Israelite standing thoughtfully at a fork in a dusty road, choosing a peaceful path away from a gathering of arrogant men who mock others and from a group of corrupt people exchanging approving glances. The righteous person carries no weapons and displays no pride, but holds a scroll of God's instruction and studies it with sincere concentration. Transition the landscape naturally toward a flourishing tree planted beside a clear, flowing stream. Its roots extend deeply into the moist soil, its branches are full of green leaves, and ripe fruit hangs from its limbs despite the dry surroundings. Nearby vegetation looks parched, emphasizing the tree's continual access to water. The image should express the contrast between a life nourished by God's instruction and one shaped by wicked counsel. Use ancient Israelite clothing, sunlit earth tones, realistic vegetation, natural water, detailed facial expressions, and a reverent atmosphere. The tree represents the enduring spiritual fruitfulness described in the psalm, not a literal historical event. No modern objects, lettering, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: The Chaff and the Two Paths
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a broad open threshing floor in ancient Israel during a dry, windy day. On one side, a farmer lifts harvested grain and separates the light chaff from the heavier kernels. Thin scraps of chaff are carried away by the wind, scattered into the empty air and unable to remain in place. In the background, show two contrasting paths through the landscape: one firm, green path leading toward a peaceful stream and healthy trees, and another dusty path dissolving into a barren, indistinct distance. A small group of upright travelers walks steadily along the first path, while isolated figures on the second path appear uncertain and divided, their footprints disappearing into loose dust. The visual language must communicate the psalm's contrast between the stability of the righteous and the impermanence of the wicked, as well as God's knowledge of the righteous person's way and the eventual ruin of the wicked way. Do not depict judgment as a specific battle or invent a particular historical incident. Historically plausible tools, woven clothing, grain, and dry Mediterranean scenery; natural lighting and realistic textures. No modern objects, lettering, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: The Nations Plot in Vain
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a grand council of ancient Near Eastern rulers assembled in a fortified royal hall. Kings and political leaders from neighboring nations sit around a stone table covered with simple maps, clay tablets, and sealed documents. Some point angrily toward a distant Israelite stronghold, while others lean close in secret consultation, their expressions revealing resentment and determination. Soldiers and standard-bearers stand behind the leaders, creating an atmosphere of political tension without beginning an actual battle. The rulers are conspiring against the LORD and His anointed king, speaking as though divine authority and established bonds can simply be cast aside. The distant fortress should suggest Jerusalem without turning the scene into a specific documented siege. Through an open archway, the sky remains vast above the assembled rulers, making their confident gestures appear small against the scale of creation. Detailed ancient robes, leather sandals, stone architecture, oil lamps, woven banners without readable symbols, and natural firelight. Express rebellion, pride, and collective defiance. No modern maps, weapons, uniforms, text, or fantasy imagery.

title: The LORD Enthrones His King on Zion
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with restrained poetic symbolism. View a magnificent heavenly throne above the clouds, represented through overwhelming radiant light and majestic scale rather than a detailed or literal portrait of God. The throne remains serene while, far below, the rulers of the nations continue their anxious council. Their gestures appear increasingly insignificant beneath the vast sky. Transition the visual composition toward Mount Zion and ancient Jerusalem, where the LORD's appointed king sits securely in a dignified royal setting. The king wears historically plausible Israelite royal clothing, a simple crown, and a richly woven mantle, with the stone walls and terraces of the city behind him. His posture is calm and authoritative rather than boastful. The picture should contrast the heavenly ruler's unshaken authority with the frantic plans of earthly powers, illustrating the divine declaration that the king has been established on Zion. Do not present God as an ordinary human political figure or invent a literal scene of divine laughter. Use luminous naturalistic atmosphere, realistic stonework, muted gold light, deep blue sky, and cinematic depth. No modern objects, written captions, or magical effects.

title: The Royal Decree and the Inheritance of the Nations
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite king stands before a gathering of court officials in an ancient royal chamber, reciting a solemn royal decree. A senior scribe holds an unrolled parchment while witnesses listen attentively, and guards remain respectfully at the doorway. The king's posture is deliberate and assured, representing the declaration of his relationship to God as expressed in the psalm's royal language. Through tall openings, show the broad world beyond Jerusalem: distant cities, mountains, coastlands, fields, and settlements stretching toward the horizon, suggesting the nations offered as the king's inheritance. Near the foreground, a potter's finished clay vessels rest on a low workbench. One small vessel is cracked, a restrained visual symbol for the fragile resistance of earthly kingdoms before the authority described in the psalm. Do not depict a literal divine family scene or an actual campaign of conquest. Emphasize royal covenant, declared authority, and the worldwide scope of the promise. Historically plausible Israelite robes, parchment, wooden furniture, clay pottery, and stone architecture; realistic sunlight and detailed materials. No modern objects, readable text, or exaggerated fantasy imagery.

title: A Warning to Kings and Refuge for Those Who Trust
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a gathering of ancient kings and advisers receives a solemn warning from a respected messenger standing on the steps of a royal assembly hall. The rulers who previously appeared proud now listen with thoughtful, humbled expressions; some set aside their weapons and turn toward a place of worship, while others exchange uncertain glances. The messenger gestures toward a raised sanctuary and toward a sheltered city gate, symbolizing the invitation to serve the LORD with reverence, accept instruction, and take refuge in Him. In the distance, ordinary families enter a fortified city through an open gate, finding protection within its stone walls. The composition should hold both the seriousness of divine judgment and the invitation to blessed refuge, without portraying cruelty or claiming that these are specific historical kings. Ancient Near Eastern robes, leather belts, stone steps, carved wooden doors, olive trees, and warm late-afternoon light. Dignified, contemplative, realistic faces and body language. No modern objects, written captions, or fantasy effects.

title: A Prayer While Enemies Surround David
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, in the setting associated with David's flight from Absalom, depict David resting in a modest refuge outside Jerusalem. He wears practical ancient Israelite clothing and a travel cloak, with a small group of exhausted but loyal companions at a respectful distance. Beyond the rocky ridge, scattered campfires and distant silhouettes suggest that many adversaries oppose him. One companion looks toward the horizon with concern, reflecting the claim that many say God will not deliver David. David, however, turns his face upward in prayer, one hand resting over his chest and the other lifted slightly. Behind him, a large protective rock formation and the fading glow of dawn create a visual metaphor for the LORD as shield and the One who lifts David's head. A faint suggestion of Jerusalem's walls appears far away. Preserve the emotional tension between danger and confident prayer. Historical fabrics, rough stone, sparse scrubland, realistic human proportions, natural light, and a restrained sense of divine protection. No visible supernatural warrior, modern equipment, or written text.

title: He Lies Down, Sleeps, and Rises Sustained by God
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an early morning camp in the rocky hills of ancient Israel. David rises from a simple woven sleeping mat beneath a shelter made of rough cloth and branches. His face shows the relief of a man who has passed through a night of danger and nevertheless rested in trust. Loyal companions begin to stir, while the first sunlight illuminates the camp and nearby hills. David stands upright, steady and composed, expressing the psalm's confession that he lay down, slept, and awoke because the LORD sustained him. In the middle distance, distant adversaries remain visible but do not dominate the frame. The composition should also evoke David's prayer for deliverance and his confidence that victory and salvation belong to God. Any suggestion of enemies being struck should remain poetic and non-graphic, not a staged battle or violent injury. Authentic ancient garments, leather water skins, simple bedding, stony terrain, distant olive trees, natural dawn light, and detailed expressions. No modern objects, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Answer Me When I Call
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands in a quiet courtyard in ancient Jerusalem at the close of day, praying to the LORD who has previously enlarged his life in distress. His expression conveys both urgency and trust as he looks upward, asking God to hear his prayer. Behind him, several prominent men stand in a tense conversation, their faces turned away from him; they symbolize people who dishonor the faithful, pursue falsehood, and love empty things. David does not confront them physically. Instead, he remains apart in prayerful composure. The setting includes limestone walls, an oil lamp, a wooden doorway, and a glimpse of the fading sky. His raised hand is restrained, showing a solemn petition rather than theatrical despair. The atmosphere conveys the psalm's instruction to tremble before wrongdoing, avoid sin, reflect quietly in one's heart, and be still. Represent the inward spiritual counsel visually, without adding written words or literal thought bubbles. Authentic Israelite garments, realistic faces, subdued evening colors, and natural shadows. No modern objects or fantasy effects.

title: Offer Right Sacrifices and Rest in Peace
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a quiet Israelite household at night after the day's work has ended. In the courtyard, a family prepares a small, appropriate offering in keeping with ancient Israelite worship, while the head of the household prays sincerely rather than displaying outward piety for others to see. A neighbor nearby looks worried about uncertain harvests and asks where good can be found; the faithful worshipper responds with a calm, hopeful expression. Through an open doorway, warm lamplight falls across sleeping mats. David reclines peacefully in the foreground, his face relaxed, while the night sky deepens over Jerusalem. The scene should communicate the psalm's movement from a call to trust in the LORD to the greater joy He gives, a joy deeper than the abundance of grain and wine. Emphasize inner security amid external uncertainty. Show historically plausible food stores, clay jars, woven mats, lamps, simple garments, and a starry ancient Near Eastern sky. No modern furniture, bottles, text, or supernatural spectacle.

title: David Brings His Morning Prayer
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, early dawn over ancient Jerusalem. David is awake before sunrise on a rooftop or open terrace overlooking the quiet city, seated beside a small oil lamp and a rolled parchment. He lifts his face toward the paling sky and speaks earnestly to God, his hands open in petition. The city below is only beginning to stir: a distant household lights a fire, a gatekeeper prepares for the morning, and birds gather on nearby stone walls. The light is soft and blue-gold, marking the stillness of the early hour. David's posture shows that prayer is the first concern of his day: he directs his words to the LORD, lays his requests before Him, and waits expectantly. Do not depict an elaborate temple ceremony here, since these opening verses chiefly present the act of prayer and waiting. Historically plausible architecture, linen and wool clothing, clay oil lamps, natural light, detailed stonework, and a calm, contemplative composition. No modern objects, written captions, or fantasy effects.

title: God Rejects Evil but Welcomes the Faithful Worshipper
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with careful symbolic staging in ancient Israel. In the foreground, David approaches the sanctuary with humility and reverence, bowing his head as he prepares to worship in God's holy presence. His clothing is modest, and his expression reflects awe rather than entitlement. Beyond the courtyard, place a contrasting group of dishonest and violent men in shadow, one exchanging a concealed pouch with another while a third speaks arrogantly. Their conduct symbolizes the psalm's teaching that evil, deceit, bloodshed, and pride are abhorrent to God; avoid presenting the shadows as a literal supernatural force. The sanctuary area remains orderly and dignified, with stone paving, woven curtains, bronze vessels, and priests performing their duties in historically grounded garments. Morning sunlight falls upon David and the sacred entrance, while the dishonest group remains outside the worship space. The visual contrast should express God's holiness and David's trust in His abundant mercy. No graphic violence, modern objects, readable signage, or fantasy imagery.

title: Lead Me in Righteousness and Surround the Righteous with Favor
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David walks along a difficult path toward Jerusalem, praying for the LORD to lead him in righteousness because of the people who oppose him. The path passes between rough stones and the walls of an ancient settlement, symbolizing the need for a straight and reliable way. In the middle distance, several adversaries speak with deceitful expressions; one gestures falsely toward David, while another turns aside from an honest witness. Keep their actions non-graphic and do not invent a specific crime beyond the psalm's description of deceit and hostility. Further along the road, faithful families and humble worshippers move toward safety and worship with expressions of hope. A gentle arc of sunlight falls around the group as a visual metaphor for divine favor and protection, not a literal visible shield. Include the sense that evil will be judged, the righteous may rejoice in God, and those who trust Him find refuge. Ancient Hebrew clothing, dusty paths, olive trees, realistic landscape, warm directional sunlight, and balanced composition. No modern objects, text, or fantasy effects.

title: David's Lament in Sickness and Distress
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a dim but believable room in an ancient Israelite dwelling. David sits on a low sleeping mat, visibly exhausted by grief and distress. His eyes are heavy, his shoulders are slumped, and tears have darkened the woven fabric near his face. A small clay water vessel and a folded cloak sit nearby, while a simple oil lamp gives off a weak glow. He reaches one hand outward in prayer, pleading not to be rebuked in anger or disciplined in wrath and asking the LORD to show mercy because he feels weak. His posture and expression convey trembling, inner anguish, and the sense that his whole being is troubled, without depicting any graphic illness or injury. The room is quiet, with rough plaster, wooden beams, and a narrow opening showing the dark night. The image should feel intimate and emotionally honest, presenting a faithful person who brings suffering directly to God. Historically accurate materials and clothing, restrained shadow, realistic tearful expression. No modern medical equipment, graphic details, captions, or supernatural apparitions.

title: The LORD Hears the Weeping and Prayer
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, continue the setting of David's night of distress, but show the emotional movement from grief toward renewed confidence. David sits alone after a long night of weeping, his eyes tired and his face marked by sorrow. He has set aside his cloak and leans forward in prayer. Through the narrow opening of the room, the first faint light of dawn begins to appear. The shadows of hostile figures once suggested outside the dwelling now recede into the distance; they are symbolic of opposition rather than specific people being defeated. David raises his head with an expression of renewed conviction, believing that the LORD has heard his plea and received his prayer. The scene should show that the psalm begins in anguish and ends with confidence that enemies will retreat in shame, without depicting their suffering. Maintain a sober and compassionate mood, using the visual details of an oil lamp nearly spent, woven textiles, rough stone, and soft dawn light to mark the change. Ancient Israelite setting, natural proportions, subtle emotion. No modern objects, visible writing, or fantasy effects.

title: David Takes Refuge and Appeals for a Just Verdict
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, the scene associated with David's appeal concerning Cush the Benjamite. In an ancient Israelite courtyard, David kneels before the LORD in earnest prayer, asking for refuge from those pursuing him. His expression combines fear of injustice with a willingness to be judged fairly. Nearby, the formal setting resembles a modest public hearing: several elders sit on stone benches while a disputed accusation is represented by men speaking sharply and gesturing toward David. Keep the accusers at a respectful distance, and do not portray a documented confrontation that the psalm does not specify. David's open hands show that he is not hiding from an honest verdict; the imagery reflects his declaration that, if he has committed the wrongdoing alleged, he accepts the consequences. A sturdy stone wall and broad rocky hill form a natural shelter behind him, symbolizing God as refuge. Authentic tunics, mantles, leather sandals, stone paving, and clay lamps. The image should stress the urgency of seeking protection and the seriousness of a truthful appeal. No modern courtroom objects, captions, or graphic violence.

title: God Judges the Peoples with Righteousness
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with symbolic elements grounded in the ancient Israelite understanding of justice. Show a broad gathering place before a fortified city where people from different households and communities stand awaiting a fair judgment. In the central foreground, David prays with his face lifted and one arm extended, asking the LORD to rise in righteous anger against wrongdoing and to establish justice. A respected elder stands beside a simple stone seat used for local judgments, listening carefully while ordinary people wait in a calm, orderly arrangement. Beyond them, depict the LORD's sovereignty symbolically through a vast, luminous sky above the city and mountains; do not portray God as an ordinary human judge. The varied people represent the nations gathered before divine judgment, and the balanced layout expresses the psalm's request that the righteous be vindicated because God tests hearts and minds. A small shield resting near David can suggest God's protection of the upright. The atmosphere is solemn, just, and dignified, not vengeful or violent. Ancient robes, realistic faces, warm stone textures, natural sky, no modern symbols, writing, or fantasy creatures.

title: The Wicked Fall into Their Own Trap
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a dry landscape outside an ancient Israelite town, used to visualize the psalm's imagery of consequences returning upon the wrongdoer. In the foreground, a dishonest man who has been preparing a hidden pit and shaping a harmful plan discovers that the ground beneath his own feet is unstable. His tools lie scattered beside the unfinished trap, and his expression changes from confidence to alarm as he recognizes his own folly. No one is injured, and the scene remains non-graphic. On a nearby rise, David stands at a safe distance with his head bowed in gratitude, acknowledging divine justice rather than celebrating another person's suffering. In the background, townspeople resume their ordinary work, and the sky opens to a clear, sunlit horizon. The imagery should encompass the psalm's warning about persistent wrongdoing, the consequences of evil schemes, the metaphor of a weapon prepared for unjust purposes, and David's final commitment to praise the LORD's righteousness. Show no literal supernatural bow, arrows, or divine attack; any references to weapons remain restrained and symbolic. Ancient clothing, stone paths, realistic soil and tools. No modern objects, text, or graphic violence.

title: The Majesty of God's Name Under the Heavens
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an expansive night landscape in ancient Israel beneath an immense star-filled sky. David stands on a rocky ridge outside a small settlement, looking upward in wonder at the moon, stars, and vast darkness of the heavens. The surrounding hills are quiet, and a few sheep rest below beside a shepherd's shelter. The sky dominates the composition, making the human figure appear very small without making the scene bleak. In the distance, a child and an elderly shepherd look up as well, evoking the psalm's surprising image of praise emerging from the mouths of infants and children. Do not literally place a supernatural inscription or visible divine face in the sky. Instead, use the scale and beauty of creation to express the majesty of God's name across the earth and David's amazement that the Creator pays attention to human beings. Show stars, moonlight, the rocky Judean landscape, simple ancient garments, and natural night lighting with realistic color and depth. No modern telescopes, buildings, constellations labeled with text, or fantasy effects.

title: Humanity Given a Place of Honor in Creation
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with an expansive view of the created world, illustrating the psalm's wonder that human beings receive honor and responsibility beneath God. In the foreground, a shepherd tends sheep and goats on a green hillside while another person guides cattle near cultivated fields. In the middle distance, horses and other domesticated animals move along a path; wild birds cross the sky, and fish-filled waters can be glimpsed below the ridge. The scene should suggest humanity's stewardship over the works of God's hands, not unrestricted exploitation or domination for vanity. A child watches a bird from the grass, while an adult gently directs livestock away from a narrow stream. Above them, mountains and open sky convey the scale of creation. The small human figures remain visibly dependent on the world around them, even as they are entrusted with responsibility within it. Keep all animal species appropriate to the ancient Near Eastern landscape, using historically plausible clothing, farming tools, flocks, terrain, and water. The atmosphere is grateful and contemplative, reflecting the repeated praise that God's name is majestic throughout the earth. No modern farm machinery, fences of modern design, captions, or fantasy animals.

title: Praise for God's Wonderful Works and Righteous Judgment
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands in a public gathering place in ancient Jerusalem, leading a sincere song of thanksgiving. Musicians with historically plausible lyres and hand drums accompany worshippers whose faces show gratitude and awe. David lifts one hand while looking toward the heavens, praising God with his whole heart and recounting wonderful works. Nearby, a family listens while an elder recalls deliverance from oppression. The distant city gates and stone walls evoke a community that has experienced God's protection, while the open space gives a sense of public remembrance and testimony. Through subtle visual symbolism, show the former confidence of hostile powers giving way to deserted military tents and abandoned banners far beyond the city, but avoid claiming a particular named battle or depicting graphic defeat. The composition should communicate joy in God's name, rejoicing in His salvation, and gratitude that hostile powers cannot stand forever against righteous judgment. Authentic woven garments, stone architecture, musical instruments, natural daylight, detailed expressions, and realistic ancient Israelite culture. No modern instruments, recognizable contemporary flags, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: The LORD Reigns and Remembers the Afflicted
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a fortified ancient Israelite city with a broad public gate and a simple place where elders hear the concerns of vulnerable people. In the foreground, a widow, a father with a child, and an elderly laborer stand near the gate, speaking to a trusted community elder. Their faces express concern, but they are treated with dignity and careful attention. David stands nearby in prayerful confidence, acknowledging that the LORD reigns, judges the world with righteousness, and provides justice for peoples. A strong stone tower above the city symbolizes the LORD as a high refuge for the oppressed in times of trouble, while the open gate signals welcome to those seeking help. Beyond the walls, the landscape extends toward distant settlements, suggesting that God's rule and care reach beyond one city. The scene should convey divine justice, trust for those who know God's name, and remembrance of the needy whose cries are not forgotten. Do not portray God as a visible earthly monarch or reduce refuge to a literal fortress alone; let the architecture function as symbolism. Historically plausible robes, clay lamps, stonework, realistic faces, natural sunlight. No modern legal objects, written signs, or fantasy imagery.

title: Deliver Me from the Gates of Death
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with carefully restrained symbolic imagery. David stands near the gate of ancient Jerusalem, looking toward the city with a mixture of sorrow and hope as he prays for mercy amid suffering. The city's gateway is solid stone, with massive wooden doors open to a public square where people gather to praise God for deliverance. At the far edge of the composition, a shadowed valley beyond the walls represents the threat of death, but do not depict corpses or graphic suffering. A narrow path leads away from that dark valley toward the busy city gate and a sunlit place of worship, visualizing rescue from the gates of death and the testimony of salvation among the people. In a separate symbolic detail, a proud oppressor's foot catches at the edge of a concealed pit he had prepared for another, suggesting that the wicked are caught by their own schemes. Do not present this as a specific historical event. Emphasize David's desire to rejoice in God's salvation and the principle that the LORD makes Himself known through righteous judgment. Ancient stonework, linen robes, wood grain, realistic shadows, clear natural light. No graphic violence, modern objects, or captions.

title: The Nations Remember Their Mortality Before God
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a solemn gathering of representatives from surrounding nations near an ancient city gate. Their clothes and travel goods distinguish different regions of the ancient Near East without relying on modern national symbols. David stands among the Israelites, praying that arrogant peoples will recognize the limits of human power and know that they are mortal. In the background, a high stone throne-like seat used for civic authority remains empty beneath the open sky, visually suggesting that no earthly ruler occupies the place of divine sovereignty. A few wealthy leaders lower their heads and listen while poor families stand visibly present among the crowd, reflecting the promise that the needy will not be forgotten and the hope of the afflicted will not perish forever. The scene should be serious but not threatening, conveying accountability, humility, and hope for the oppressed. Do not show supernatural terror or invent a mass punishment. Use grounded ancient clothing, realistic city walls, clay vessels, fabric canopies, and late-afternoon light. No modern flags, weapons of modern design, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: Why Does God Seem Far Away?
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a poor Israelite family stands at the edge of a crowded ancient settlement while a powerful landholder and his associates move confidently through the marketplace. The vulnerable family watches with concern as the wealthy men ignore the needs of others. On a rocky rise nearby, David sits alone in prayer, looking toward the settlement and asking why the LORD seems distant in times of trouble. His expression is troubled but faithful, showing the anguish of a person who cannot understand why injustice appears to prosper. The powerful man is dressed in richer but historically plausible clothing and wears an expression of self-importance; he should not resemble any known modern public figure. The image should illustrate the psalm's accusation that the wicked boast of their desires, bless greed, and live as though they need not answer to God. Avoid literalizing the claim that God is hidden as though God has physically abandoned the world. Use the settlement's narrow streets, woven awnings, baskets of grain, stone dwellings, and realistic body language to show social inequality. No modern money, signs, machinery, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: The Arrogant Oppressor and the Hidden Trap
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a sequence of actions within one coherent ancient Israelite marketplace and its surrounding alleys. A proud and prosperous man walks confidently through the streets, speaking with contempt and acting as though consequences will never reach him. His companions follow, encouraging his arrogance. Nearby, a poor traveler and a vulnerable household pass through a narrow lane, unaware that the powerful man is watching them with predatory intent. In a shadowed doorway, the oppressor conceals a dishonest plan, while a coarse woven cloak partly hides his hands. Down the alley, a trap-like pit prepared in the earth represents the psalm's imagery of ambush and harm; keep it clear enough to understand without depicting anyone injured. The wealthy man's face and gestures express the belief that God does not see or call his actions to account. The victims are ordinary people, not caricatures, and their dignity should remain central. Use realistic ancient robes, limestone alleys, market baskets, clay pots, dusty ground, and strong contrasts between bright streets and shaded recesses. The image must expose arrogance, deceit, and exploitation without glamorizing the oppressor or depicting graphic violence. No modern objects, readable text, or fantasy creatures.

title: Arise, O LORD: Defend the Fatherless and Oppressed
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a moving prayer scene beside an ancient Israelite settlement. David kneels on rough stone, raising both hands toward the heavens and asking the LORD to arise, remember the afflicted, and break the power of wickedness. Beside him stand a widow, a fatherless child, and an elderly poor laborer, each representing the vulnerable people whose rights are being ignored. Their expressions show hardship but also hope that someone has heard their appeal. In the middle distance, a proud oppressor stands at the entrance of a substantial house while local elders listen to the complaints of ordinary families. One elder gives the child and widow his full attention, signaling that their cause matters. The sky above David brightens after dark clouds, a visual metaphor for the conviction that the LORD sees trouble and grief, helps the helpless, and establishes justice. Do not depict an invented supernatural battle or an explicit divine figure. The final mood should be one of solemn confidence that God hears the meek, strengthens their hearts, defends the fatherless and oppressed, and brings earthly arrogance to an end. Historically plausible Israelite clothing, stone houses, oil lamps, natural light, realistic emotional expressions. No modern objects, written captions, or fantasy effects.
